environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind an AWS Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB target group forwards traffic on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB SG to instance on 8080. PostgreSQL RDS instance in same VPC with appuser having SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables. No additional managed rule groups attached to ALB. API keys distributed to partner integrations.

config.alb: internet-facing, HTTPS listener, default action forward to target group
config.rds: PostgreSQL 15, appuser has standard DML privileges on public schema
config.network: VPC with public/private subnets, RDS in private subnet
config.iam: EC2 instance role with SSM and CloudWatch only
